name: @stewardmd/capacitor-iap
description: Minimal StoreKit 2 in-app-purchase bridge for StewardMD Pro (iOS 15+). Fetches products, runs a purchase and returns the verified transaction id; the server (functions/_iap.js) re-validates it via the App Store Server API and grants the Pro entitlement. iOS-only for now; Android Play Billing added later.
author: StewardMD
_note: iOS-only StoreKit 2. Requires the App Store Connect Paid Applications agreement to be active and the subscription products (in.stewardmd.pro.monthly / in.stewardmd.pro.annual) to exist before purchases work. Device-test in the StoreKit sandbox before shipping.
